stories.headline: Disney D23 Takeaway: With ‘X-Men’, ‘Tangled’, ‘Incredibles 3’ & More, Movie Studio Poised To Slay In 2028 - Deadline
stories.summary: Disney at D23 unveiled big tentpoles for its 2028 in what could be a great box office year with 'Tangled', 'Lilo & Stitch 2', 'X-Men' and 'Ghost Rider' and more.
stories.why: X-Men's MCU arrival signals Marvel finally reclaiming its most valuable IP after 20 years; for guys who grew up on these characters, this is the culmination of a decade-long wait to see them done right in the MCU.

stories.headline: Ray J v Orlando Brown and Tesehki v Big Lex boxing fight LIVE stream info, results and more from Zeus Network card - Bloody Elbow
stories.summary: Ray J steps back into the ring for a big fight with Orlando Brown tonight in Atlanta
stories.why: Celebrity boxing (Ray J vs. Orlando Brown) has become the primary way former entertainers stay relevant and profitable; watching it reveals who's still got cultural pull versus who's fading into obscurity.

stories.headline: Jessica Simpson turns heads in bikini photos from trip to Turks and Caicos - Fox News
stories.summary: Jessica Simpson shared bikini photos from her Turks and Caicos birthday trip on Instagram, lounging in a black polka dot two-piece in paradise.
stories.why: Jessica Simpson at 43 reclaiming her body image narrative publicly matters because she spent decades being defined by her weight—this is her flipping the script that controlled her for years.

stories.headline: Netflix fires back at Tyra Banks’ defamation claims over ‘ANTM’ documentary in nasty legal war - Page Six
stories.summary: Banks sued the streaming giant in June.
stories.why: Netflix's legal pushback against Tyra Banks signals streamers are now powerful enough to fight back against talent over documentary narratives, reshaping who controls the story of reality TV.

stories.headline: Kingdom Hearts 4 Gets Extended Gameplay Trailer Featuring Playable Mickey, Donald, and Goofy | D23 2026 - IGN
stories.summary: Disney and Square Enix showed up for the Deep Dive into Kingdom Hearts panel at D23 2026 to show off an extended gameplay trailer for Kingdom Hearts 4 that features a first look at a playable King Mi…
stories.why: Kingdom Hearts 4 going multiplayer-focused (Mickey, Donald, Goofy playable) marks the franchise pivoting from solo nostalgia play to social gaming, targeting the guy who wants his childhood friends literally in the game.

stories.headline: ‘SNL’ Alum John Higgins Joins ‘Scrubs’ For Major Role In Season 2 Of ABC Revival - Deadline
stories.summary: Saturday Night Live alum John Higgins has joined the cast of ABC's Scrubs for a major recurring role in the upcoming second season of the revival.
stories.why: SNL actors joining established revivals like Scrubs signals that live sketch comedy is now a farm league for prestige TV, not the peak—it's a meaningful shift in where comedy talent actually wants to land.

stories.headline: BREAKING: Millennium Falcon: Smuggler's Run Coming to Fortnite, Will Interact at Parks - WDW News Today
stories.why: Millennium Falcon in Fortnite collapses the boundary between gaming and theme parks into one ecosystem; for guys who care about Star Wars, their experience now spans simultaneously from their couch to Orlando.

stories.headline: VisionQuest trailer kicks off Disney’s D23 fan event - Ars Technica
stories.summary: Also: Ahsoka S2 teaser, Doomsday trailer, news about MCU's X-Men and Star Wars: Starfighter...
stories.why: Ahsoka S2, Doomsday, and MCU X-Men news all dropping at once shows Disney is front-loading 2025-26 with legacy IP to dominate streaming wars—this is the company's bet that nostalgia franchises will win the streaming consolidation battle.
